div.head: Ymb Æwbricas Not known to Liebermann
div.ab: And on your question about adulterers, whether with nuns or lay women, the forfeited woman and man go respectively to the bishopric with her third, and to the lord – whether it be bookland or folkland, whether of the king himself or of any man – he goes with his two parts to his lord if he has wicked intercourse, and they are both forfeit.

note.label: closest to an echo

note.label: same offence stigmatized
note.quote: at the time when such offences were stigmatized by Edmund's London council [n. I Em 4]
